description.value: COCO Cafe is a mission-driven community cafe in the rural Cedar area, operated by Cedar Opportunities BC Society, a registered charity that provides supported employment and training for adults with developmental disabilities. The cafe serves a made-from-scratch breakfast and lunch menu featuring eggs benedict, breakfast bowls, waffles, and handhelds alongside coffee and beverages. Touring cyclists will find a warm, inclusive community hub with outdoor seating and online takeout ordering available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is fully functional and confirms COCO Cafe is an active community cafe operated by Cedar Opportunities BC Society at #4A - 1840 Cedar Road in Cedar, BC. Takeout is confirmed by the website's 'Order Take-Out' navigation link and the 'Coco-on-the-Go Quick Menu' for online ordering. A 'Vegetarian Eggs Benedict' is listed explicitly on the menu, confirming at least vegetarian options; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or OSM tags beyond outdoor_seating=yes.
concerns: OSM address is missing the unit number '#4A'; website consistently lists '#4A - 1840 Cedar Road' — updated in address field.

OSM opening_hours (Th-Su 08:00-14:00) appears significantly outdated; website contact and order pages state Monday–Sunday 7:30 am–3:00 pm, suggesting the OSM hours were not updated when the cafe expanded its schedule.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe with a confirmed website, full menu, and community mission; straightforward include for the directory.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists 'Vegetarian Eggs Benedict' (poached eggs, roasted red peppers, tomato, avocado, hollandaise) as a named menu item
